skills.name: Basic
skills.desc: Deals 120% ATK DMG to a single target.

skills.name: Ultimate
skills.desc: Deals 900% ATK as Direct DMG to all enemies in a column with a 3-hit combo. Each hit additionally deals 600% ATK DMG as [True DMG]. Each hit can trigger [Specialized Breakthrough] once. [True DMG]: Not affected by DMG Rate or DMG Free, and deals Direct DMG without [DMG Sharing] or [Evasion]. [Specialized Breakthrough]: Instantly removes [DMG Ignoration].

skills.name: Ultra-Ultimate
skills.desc: Deals 1200% ATK as Direct DMG to all enemies in a column with a 3-hit combo. Each hit additionally deals 840% ATK DMG as [True DMG]. Each hit can trigger [Specialized Breakthrough] once. [True DMG]: Not affected by DMG Rate or DMG Free, and deals Direct DMG without [DMG Sharing] or [Evasion]. [Specialized Breakthrough]: Instantly removes [DMG Ignoration].

skills.name: Passive
skills.desc: Gains 60% [Specialized Dodge]. When any character acts, if own accumulated DMG exceeds Max HP, triggers a [Rampage Pursuit] attack with 180% Ultimate DMG. This skill is not affected by the additional consumption effect caused by [Specialized Panic] and prioritizes the front row. Can activate up to 10 times per battle. [Specialized Dodge]: Direct DMG, Continuous DMG, Injury DMG, and Extra DMG only deal 1 point of DMG.

skills.name: Extreme Passive
skills.desc: Gains 70% [Specialized Dodge]. When any character acts, if own accumulated DMG exceeds Max HP, triggers a [Rampage Pursuit] attack with 180% Ultimate DMG. This skill is not affected by the additional consumption effect caused by [Specialized Panic] and prioritizes the front row. Can activate up to 11 times per battle. [Specialized Dodge]: Direct DMG, Continuous DMG, Injury DMG, and Extra DMG only deal 1 point of DMG.

skills.name: 5★ Passive
skills.desc: Gains 80% [Specialized Dodge]. When any character acts, if own accumulated DMG exceeds Max HP, triggers a [Rampage Pursuit] attack with 180% Ultimate DMG. This skill is not affected by the additional consumption effect caused by [Specialized Panic] and prioritizes the front row. Can activate up to 12 times per battle. [Specialized Dodge]: Direct DMG, Continuous DMG, Injury DMG, and Extra DMG only deal 1 point of DMG.

skills.name: Awaken 1 Passive
skills.desc: At battle start, gains [Regroup] and grants all allies 150% [Injury Reduction]. [Regroup]: After being defeated, returns to the battlefield with 80% HP and increases own ATK% for 1 round. Can trigger up to 7 times. [Injury Reduction]: Reduces [Injury], [Internal Injury], and [Charge] DMG.

skills.name: Awaken 2 Passive
skills.desc: At battle start, gains [Regroup] and grants all allies 200% [Injury Reduction]. [Regroup]: After being defeated, returns to the battlefield with 100% HP and increases own ATK by 35% for 1 round. Can trigger up to 10 times. [Injury Reduction]: Reduces [Injury], [Internal Injury], and [Charge] DMG.

effects.desc: Revive effect: after being defeated, return to the battle with 80% Health and gain +20% ST for 1 turn, up to 7 times.
Effect reduces Injury, Internal Injury and Cumulative damage taken.
Evasion PvP tier — reduces specialized attacks to 1 damage; pierced by the ignore dodge effect.
Damage over time based on ST, disappears after activation; Can Detonate to explode.
This type of bonus damage is dealt on top of attacks, is reduced by Evasion-type effects, and can be immune after a certain number of turns.
